method: Actual-source independent multilingual small/medium ASR, English medium.en ASR, Silero VAD (repo gap attestation) and AudioSet AST classifier cross-evidence; no human listening claim. Empty ASR does not attest silence, and classifier scores do not identify words or speakers.
limitations: AudioSet AST ranks the venue music bed first on this window (Music 0.546), then Crowd 0.135, with Speech at 0.031 — against Speech 0.897 on the interpreter-speech control window [86.0, 90.9] and Speech 0.357 on the resumption control window [94.8, 99.0]. Applause and the PA music bed dominate; unidentified crowd voices remain possible.

Multilingual medium's Chinese pass opens a segment at 94.13s (然后当然) that is its decoding of Rybakina's English resumption 'And of course …' — the resumption's first word is timed 94.76s in the landed caption stream (94.79s in the medium.en rerun). Treated as resumption-onset smear at the window edge, not gap-internal speech.
The interpreter's final word 大家 ends at 90.90s (medium) / 90.59s (small); the window opens at 90.90s, so the annotation covers no subtitled word.

The cited Silero VAD attestation is a snapshot taken on the previous duration-less caption grid: its 89.9–94.8 row reports 0.93s of voice-like activity and the boundary fragments of the two adjacent subtitled sentences （次感谢大家 / Then). That span includes subtitled speech before 90.90s, and music-bed/cheering energy can trigger VAD; the attestation regenerates on the current grid at the next subs run. Voice-activity evidence is retained rather than relabeled silence.
medium.en force-decodes parts of the Chinese interpretation elsewhere in this bilingual recording; those outputs are excluded as native-speech evidence.

audioset_ast.preprocessing: 16kHz mono float PCM scaled to the int16 amplitude domain; Kaldi-compatible fbank128 (numpy implementation): pre-emphasis 0.97, 25ms Hanning window (povey exponent 0.85), 10ms hop, HTK mel scale 20-8000Hz, log floor 1e-10; right-padded to 1024 frames with 0.0 after normalization (fbank - (-4.2677393)) / (2 * 4.5689974).

silero_vad.note: Snapshot of the repo gap attestation (previous caption grid). Its 89.9–94.8 row: 0.93s voice-like activity, second-ASR words are boundary fragments of the adjacent subtitled sentences. The file regenerates on the current grid; human-voice activity evidence is retained rather than relabeled silence.
